name: token-arena-platform
description: Multiplayer internal-token gaming platform foundation (Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Durable Objects, React, Firebase Auth).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @arena/api" "npm run dev -w @arena/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/games/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @arena/api
